errors.evidence: The description of the y-axis range is incomplete. The axis is mirrored, extending from 8% at the top to 8% at the bottom, centered at 0%. Stating the range is simply 'from 0% to 8%' misrepresents the structure of the axis.
The chart does not use stacked bars. For each category, two bars are plotted in opposite directions (one up, one down) from the central 0% baseline. They are not stacked on top of each other.

The description fails to mention that the categories are sorted in descending order of their corresponding values. The statement that they are arranged 'from left to right' is trivially true but misses the specific sorting pattern, which was explicitly requested by the prompt.
